tavern.name: The Broken Flagon Tavern
tavern.description: A dimly lit tavern that smells of sweat and wood smoke. Rough-hewn tables fill the room. A fire crackles in the hearth.

street.name: Cobblestone Street
street.description: A narrow street slick with rain. Crooked buildings lean overhead. A fog hangs low.

room_21.name: Room Twenty One
room_21.description: A sparse lodging room. A straw mattress, a locked chest, and a window overlooking the street.

market.name: The Market Square
market.description: A busy square with merchant stalls. Vendors hawk their wares. The smell of roasting meat fills the air.

alley.name: Dead End Alley
alley.description: A dark alley that ends at a crumbling wall. Something scratched into the bricks catches your eye.

barkeep.name: Marta the Barkeep
barkeep.description: A heavyset woman with sharp eyes and flour on her apron. She sees everything, says little.

merchant.name: Aldric the Merchant
merchant.description: A nervous thin man who keeps glancing over his shoulder.

hooded_figure.name: The Hooded Figure
hooded_figure.description: A figure in a deep hood who stands very still.

old_key.name: Old Iron Key
old_key.description: A heavy iron key, teeth worn smooth with age.

dagger.name: Rusty Dagger
dagger.description: A short blade spotted with rust. Still sharp enough.

wanted_notice.name: Wanted Notice
wanted_notice.description: A parchment notice. A face sketched in rough charcoal. A reward: 200 gold.

locked_chest.name: Locked Chest
locked_chest.description: A heavy wooden chest with an iron lock.

strange_coin.name: Strange Coin
strange_coin.description: A gold coin stamped with a face you do not recognise. It is warm to the touch.

scratched_message.name: Scratched Message
scratched_message.description: Words scratched into brick: 'THE KEY OPENS MORE THAN ONE DOOR'.
